name: Vyletongue Corruption
label: Quest
description: Vyletongue Corruption: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A satyr known as Vyletongue has corrupted the caverns of Maraudon, stunting the growth of many of the plants inside.
Take this vial, friend. Fill it at the corrupted orange pool found inside the caverns; the coating inside the vial will counter the toxins, turning it into a healing agent.

Find the Vylestem vines inside the orange caverns, and use the purified liquid on them. The corruption will be purged from the plant, but do know that Vyletongue will still control it. He may use it against you...

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you are able to heal the plant, it will again begin to grow. We must do what we can, friend...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for returning this, friend. With the remaining liquid you brought me, I can continue my studies.
While there is still much to do, you have helped to heal some of the corruption that Vyletongue spread through Maraudon. Please take this with my gratitude.
